description: This file defines the 'jsLanguage' class responsible for creating JavaScript cache files for language strings in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods to generate cache files for application-wide strings and module-specific strings, encoding them in JSON format and writing them to cache files.

classes.name: jsLanguage
classes.description: A class providing static methods to generate and cache JavaScript language strings for the SuiteCRM application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for jsLanguage class. It is empty and does not perform any initialization.

methods.name: createAppStringsCache
methods.description: Creates a cache JavaScript file containing application-wide language strings encoded in JSON for the specified language, defaulting to 'en_us'.

methods.name: createModuleStringsCache
methods.description: Creates a cache JavaScript file for module-specific language strings encoded in JSON, for the specified module directory and language. Can return the generated string if requested.
